Force Combat Styles

Choose Force powers for hostile control, healing, protection, or movement to an ally.

Force - Alter

Alter includes direct Force damage, area attacks, control effects, and attacks that can restore health.

Force - Control

Control includes healing, temporary protection, and movement or control powers.

Force - Sense

Sense includes attacks and effects that weaken enemies, plus ways to intercept harm aimed at an ally.

Quick Answers

What does Force focus on?
